items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: My brother Sam on planet... Walter Arnold was playing drums. Oh I know Walter Arnold.

ctx.x: You see Chris, Chris won trumpet. My brother Sam on planet. My brother E. F. was on bass. Little Jim on violin. I'm on guitar. And uh. And uh. And uh. And uh. And uh. And uh. And uh. Walter Arnold was playing drums. Oh I know Walter Arnold.
